project_structure: Monorepo architecture using Turborepo with pnpm workspaces. Key modules: apps/api (NestJS GraphQL backend with Prisma ORM), apps/web (Next.js 15 React frontend with Ant Design + ECharts), packages/mongo (MongoDB models including ProcessedItem with entities and AkshareResponse for financial data), infra/akshare (Python service for financial data fetching). The dashboard visualization layer is in apps/web/app/(app)/dashboard/ with modular chart components using a shared DashboardChart wrapper (echart.client.tsx) that supports lazy loading, theming, and dynamic module installation.

relevant_files.rationale: Core data model containing entities array (name, type, confidence) extracted from news items - primary source for graph nodes
Existing ECharts wrapper with lazy loading, theming (smart-light/smart-dark), and dynamic module installation pattern - must extend for graph series type
Financial data service with getDataByCategory() method - provides economic data points for correlation with entities
Reference implementation for dashboard chart component pattern: useQuery + apiClient + DashboardChart + CSV export + click interactions
GraphQL model with ProcessedItemPreviewModelGraph containing entities field (string array) - defines API contract for entity data
GraphQL query fetching processedPreview.entities - existing query pattern for retrieving entity data
Main dashboard layout with dynamic component loading pattern and grid structure - integration point for new graph component
GraphQL resolver for economic data queries - pattern for creating new entity-financial correlation endpoint

patterns: 1. Chart Component Pattern (sector-heatmap.tsx:90-361): useQuery with queryKey array, apiClient.get(), DashboardChart wrapper with option/theme/height/onEvents props, loading/error/empty states via ChartEmptyState component. 2. ECharts Module Loading (echart.client.tsx:192-277): Dynamic series type installation via installOnce() with switch-case pattern - add 'graph' case for force-directed layout. 3. dependencies: Frontend: echarts ^5.5.0 (already installed, supports graph series type for force-directed layout), @apollo/client ^3.11.0 (GraphQL), @tanstack/react-query ^5.51.0 (REST queries), antd ^5.19.0 (UI components), zustand ^4.5.4 (state management). Backend: @nestjs/graphql, @prisma/client (ORM), bullmq (job queues). No additional dependencies required - ECharts graph series is built-in but needs dynamic module installation.
integration_points: 1. Frontend Chart Registration (apps/web/components/echart.client.tsx:192-277): Add 'graph' case to switch statement for dynamic graph module loading. 2. Dashboard Layout (apps/web/app/(app)/dashboard/dashboard-content.tsx:307-322): Add EntityImpactGraph component in grid section alongside WarMap and SectorHeatmap. 3. Backend API Endpoint: Create new endpoint at apps/api/src/modules/dashboard/dashboard.controller.ts for entity-financial correlation data. 4. GraphQL Extension: Add new query in apps/api/src/graphql/resolvers/ for entity aggregation with financial correlation. 5. Store Integration (apps/web/store/dashboard-filters.ts): Extend filters store for entity/sector selection state if cross-filtering needed.
constraints: 1. ECharts graph series requires explicit module installation - must add to echart.client.tsx installOnce pattern. 2. ProcessedItem.entities is string array (not structured objects) in GraphQL layer - need backend aggregation for node/edge computation. 3. Akshare data is time-series based (recordedAt, value, sourceField) - correlation logic must align timestamps between news entities and financial data points. 4. Dashboard components use lazy loading via next/dynamic - new component must follow same pattern. 5. No D3.js or vis.js in current dependencies - must use ECharts graph series for consistency. 6. Entity data comes from LLM extraction (result.entities in ProcessedItem) - confidence scores available in MongoDB but flattened to strings in GraphQL.

clarification_needs.question: What correlation method should be used to establish entity-financial connections?
clarification_needs.context: The system has news entities (people/organizations) and financial time-series data (Akshare). Need to define how to compute edges between them - options range from simple co-occurrence to statistical correlation.
options: Co-occurrence frequency: Count how often an entity appears in news when a financial metric changes significantly
Time-lagged correlation: Compute Pearson/Spearman correlation between entity mention frequency and price movements with configurable lag
Sector tagging: Use predefined entity-to-sector mappings and connect entities to their sector's financial instruments
Hybrid approach: Combine co-occurrence for edge creation with correlation strength for edge weight

clarification_needs.question: Should the graph support real-time updates or be static per time range?
clarification_needs.context: Current dashboard has both static charts (sector-heatmap) and live-updating components (LiveAlertsToasts, queue events). Force-directed graphs can be computationally expensive to re-layout.
options: Static: Compute graph once per time range selection, no live updates
Incremental: Add new nodes/edges without full re-layout when new data arrives
Polling: Refresh entire graph on configurable interval (e.g., 60s)
